exposure: Universal SARS-CoV-2 testing offered in the labor and delivery unit
cohort: The study included 270 consecutive patients presenting for delivery without COVID-19 symptoms at Barnes-Jewish Hospital labor and delivery unit over a four-week period.
finding: Implementing a patient-centered approach, including offering alternative testing methods and addressing concerns, significantly increased the uptake of universal SARS-CoV-2 testing in the labor and delivery unit.
